---
title: "Seasonal ET and water use efficiency: FruitLook 20 m"
format: html
---

The same growing-season workflow as the WaPOR notebook, applied to the higher-resolution 20 m FruitLook actual-ET rasters for the earlier harvest years.

There are two differences from the WaPOR notebook:

-   FruitLook coverage is sporadic, so every month available between September and April is used. A harvest year does not need a complete season.
-   Fields are clipped to sub-region boundaries (intersection) rather than tagged by spatial join, so a field spanning two sub-regions contributes to each.

## 1. Setup

```{r setup}
library(terra)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(readr)
library(janitor)
library(openxlsx)

source("utils.R")

DATA_ROOT <- "../data"   # expected layout is described in the README
OUT_ROOT <- "../outputs"
RASTER_ROOT <- file.path(DATA_ROOT, "et", "fruitlook_20m")
SUBREGIONS_PATH <- file.path(DATA_ROOT, "subregions", "subregions.shp")
YIELD_PATH <- file.path(DATA_ROOT, "yield", "yield_data.csv")

ET_SOURCE <- "Fruitlook_20m"

dir.create(OUT_ROOT, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## 2. Raster inventory

FruitLook filenames use one of two date formats: a month name followed by the year (e.g. `october_2014`), or `rYYYY_MM`. Only one raster is kept for each month.

```{r inventory}
raster_files <- list.files(RASTER_ROOT, pattern = "\\.tif$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)

file_inventory <- tibble(filepath = normalizePath(raster_files), fname = tolower(basename(raster_files))) |>
  mutate(
    year = as.integer(coalesce(str_extract(fname, "\\d{4}"), str_extract(fname, "(?<=r)\\d{4}"))),
    month = coalesce(
      match(str_extract(fname, "[a-z]+(?=_\\d{4})"), tolower(month.name)),
      as.integer(str_extract(fname, "(?<=r\\d{4}_)\\d{2}"))
    )
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(year), !is.na(month)) |>
  distinct(year, month, .keep_all = TRUE)

# September-December belong to the following year's harvest
harvest_years <- sort(unique(if_else(file_inventory$month >= 9, file_inventory$year + 1L, file_inventory$year)))
cat("Found", nrow(file_inventory), "monthly rasters covering harvest years:", harvest_years, "\n")
```

## 3. Seasonal ET per sub-region and crop

```{r seasonal_et}
subregions_sf <- st_read(SUBREGIONS_PATH, quiet = TRUE)
yield_data <- load_yield(YIELD_PATH)

et_results <- list()

for (h_year in harvest_years) {
  survey_year <- closest_survey_year(h_year)
  season_files <- file_inventory |>
    filter((year == h_year - 1 & month >= 9) | (year == h_year & month <= 4))

  cat("\nHarvest year", h_year, "-", nrow(season_files), "rasters,", survey_year, "field boundaries\n")
  if (nrow(season_files) == 0) next

  # Rasters are monthly totals (mm), so the seasonal total is their sum
  et_season_total <- sum(rast(season_files$filepath))
  raster_crs <- st_crs(crs(et_season_total))

  farms_sf <- st_read(field_boundary_path(DATA_ROOT, survey_year), quiet = TRUE) |>
    mutate(crop_type = canonical_crop(CROPS)) |>
    filter(crop_type %in% CROP_TYPES) |>
    st_transform(raster_crs) |>
    st_make_valid()

  farms_in_regions <- st_intersection(farms_sf, st_make_valid(st_transform(subregions_sf, raster_crs)))
  if (nrow(farms_in_regions) == 0) {
    cat("  No overlap between fields and sub-regions. Skipping.\n")
    next
  }

  farms_in_regions$et_mm <- terra::extract(
    et_season_total, vect(farms_in_regions), fun = mean, na.rm = TRUE, ID = FALSE
  )[[1]]

  et_results[[as.character(h_year)]] <- farms_in_regions |>
    st_drop_geometry() |>
    group_by(sub_region = Label, crop_type) |>
    summarise(
      et_sept_apr_sum_mm = mean(et_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_fields = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    mutate(yield_year = h_year, survey_year = survey_year, et_source = ET_SOURCE)
}

et_summary <- bind_rows(et_results)
print(et_summary)
```

## 4. Join yield and calculate WUE

```{r wue}
et_wue <- add_yield_and_wue(et_summary, yield_data)
master_table <- build_master_table(yield_data, et_summary)

write_csv(et_wue, file.path(OUT_ROOT, paste0(ET_SOURCE, "_ET_WUE_Summary.csv")))
write_csv(master_table, file.path(OUT_ROOT, paste0(ET_SOURCE, "_Master_Table.csv")), na = "")
write_results_workbook(
  file.path(OUT_ROOT, paste0(ET_SOURCE, "_Results.xlsx")),
  yield_data, et_wue, master_table
)
```
